scope: Synthetic operating ventures initialized after setup; matched market seed, province, sector and capital across strategy profiles. Different skill/fixed cost/marketing/effort intentionally represent different strategies. The high/low operations-only mechanism is separately unit-tested.
limits: No claim of calibrated Vietnam startup survival or failure rates.
Cash-solvent means positive cash, nonnegative book equity and no overdue due bills at horizon; it is not legal bankruptcy status.
Lifetime 100k QA is a separate milestone, not substituted by venture/month counts.
